title: 12 Best Cheap Eats in Chiang Mai
description: Discover Chiang Mai's top 12 cheap eats for 2026! From legendary Khao Soi to succulent pork leg rice and vibrant market stalls, find delicious local food without breaking the bank. Your ultimate guide to affordable dining in Northern Thailand.

places.name: Khao Soi Khun Yai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The classic Khao Soi Gai (chicken) or Khao Soi Moo (pork).

places.name: Chang Phuak Pork Leg Rice (Khao Kha Moo Chang Phueak)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Khao Kha Moo (Pork Leg Rice) with extra egg if you're feeling indulgent.

places.name: Huen Phen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Gaeng Hung Lay (Burmese-style pork curry), Sai Oua (Northern Thai sausage), Nam Prik Ong (pork and tomato chili dip).

places.name: SP Chicken
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Whole Roasted Chicken (Gai Yang), Sticky Rice, Som Tum Thai or Laos.

places.name: Cherng Doi Roast Chicken (Gai Yang Cherng Doi)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Roast Chicken (Gai Yang), Som Tum Pla Ra (fermented fish papaya salad for the adventurous), Moo Yang (grilled pork neck).

places.name: Jok Sompet
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Jok Moo (pork congee) with an egg and crispy dough stick (pa tong go).

places.name: Tong Tem Toh
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A full 'Khan Tok' style meal with Khao Niao (sticky rice), Nam Prik Noom (green chili dip), Gaeng Hung Lay, and fried pork belly with chili.

places.name: Anchan Vegetarian Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their weekly curry special, Mango Sticky Rice, or the Vegetarian Khao Soi.

places.name: Khao Soi Mae Sai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Khao Soi Gai (chicken) or Khao Soi Nua (beef), which is a less common but delicious option here.

places.name: Paak Dang (Isaan Food)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Som Tum Pla Krob (crispy fish papaya salad), Gai Yang (grilled chicken), Pla Pao (salt-crusted grilled fish, excellent for groups).

places.name: Mr. Kai Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pad See Ew, Green Curry with Chicken, or the Spring Rolls.

places.name: Warorot Market (Kad Luang) Food Stalls
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sai Oua (Northern Thai sausage), Kanom Krok (coconut pancakes), Khao Soi (from one of the many stalls), or fresh fruit shakes.
